-77.63030,43.06450.name: Strong Fertility Center
-77.63030,43.06450.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Erin M. Masaba, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-122.26885,37.56003.name: Gilead Sciences
-122.26885,37.56003.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

-2.93282,53.24675.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. Satellite clinic to Manchester Fertility. A satellite is where patients are seen; the licence sits with the parent clinic, so the regulator's paperwork and the treatment are in different places. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

-84.07961,9.93277.name: Azul Fertility Experts
-84.07961,9.93277.desc: A centre accredited by REDLARA, the Latin American Network of Assisted Reproduction. Website: https://azulfertilityexperts.com/. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. REDLARA accreditation is voluntary and its members report to a shared registry, which is why Latin America can be read at all — most countries in the region have no national register of clinics. What it is not is a complete list: a clinic outside REDLARA appears nowhere. No street address resolved, so this point is the city or the country rather than the centre.

19.09143,47.47686.name: National Biosafety Laboratory (NBL) (Nemzeti Biztonsági Laboratórium) (OKI)
19.09143,47.47686.company: National Public Health Center (former National Center for Epidemiology)
19.09143,47.47686.desc: A BSL4 laboratory, operational. Run by National Public Health Center (former National Center for Epidemiology). It is categorised as a public health laboratory, working on human health. Personnel work in full-body positive-pressure suits with their own air supply. Containment space: 164 SqM. Operational or announced: 2007. It stands in a built-up area, with more than fifty thousand people living within two and a half miles. There is no international register of laboratories at this containment level and no obligation to declare one, so this record comes from a research project rather than a regulator. What that project could not find out is absent here too.

-77.10100,39.00000.name: NIH — dual use research of concern policy
-77.10100,39.00000.desc: The US policy requiring review of research that could be misapplied, revised in 2024 to cover more pathogen work. Compliance is a condition of federal funding rather than a law, so it reaches the funded and no one else, and privately financed work of the same kind falls outside it entirely.
